newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Sanso to post special losses of 9.5 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Sanso to post special losses of 9.5 bln yen.

text.p: Nippon Sanso Corp said on Friday that it expects to post extraordinary losses of 9.5 billion yen in the current business year to March 31 due to restructuring of its overseas operations.
Japan's largest oxygen manufacturer said that it would dissolve two of its overseas subsidiaries.
The subsidiaries are the Thermos Group of Companies of the United States and Nippon Sanso Netherlands BV.
With an additional foreign exchange loss of 1.8 billion yen, special losses in the current business year will total 11.3 billion yen, the company said in a statement.
Nevertheless, the company will maintain its earnings forecast for the business year, the statement said.
The company will sell some of its assets, including land near Tokyo, to offset the losses, the statement said.
Nippon Sanso forecasts 190 billion yen in sales, 1.9 billion yen in parent current profit and 1.3 billion yen in net profit for the year to March 31.
The dividend payout will also remain the same as the previously expected six yen per share, the statement said.
